blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — The Philippines and Peru are eyeing the creation of a Philippines-Peru Joint Trade Commission and exploring cooperation on mitigating the effects of El Niño, the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) said on Thursday. The initiatives were discussed during a bilateral meeting between President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and newly elected Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori on the sidelines of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting here.
